items.caption: A modern digital rendering of 校 in a Shuowen-style seal script. Its dense left and looped right sides correspond to 木 and 交 in the traditional analysis.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style rendering of 校 on white, with a dense left side and a rounded loop on the right.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the traditional component analysis, while its modern status distinguishes it from evidence of an ancient inscription.

limitations.text: This modern rendering is not a dated historical inscription, so it cannot establish 校’s earliest graphic form or the chronology of its development.
